# MUSA attention set

<!-- Generated by musa_operator_eval/tools/collect_attention_set.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

The attention family of the MUSA operator evaluation: every KernelBench attention problem, the A-tier answer that already exists for it, the measurement that already exists for it, and what is still missing for each target.

## 目标设备与 dtype 矩阵

| target | device | MUSA arch | warp size | dtype | status |
|---|---|---|---:|---|---|
| `s4000_fp32` | MTT S4000 | `mp_22` | 128 | fp32 | measured |
| `s4000_fp16` | MTT S4000 | `mp_22` | 128 | fp16 | planned |
| `s4000_bf16` | MTT S4000 | `mp_22` | 128 | bf16 | planned |
| `s5000_fp32` | MTT S5000 | `mp_31` | 32 | fp32 | planned |
| `s5000_fp16` | MTT S5000 | `mp_31` | 32 | fp16 | planned |
| `s5000_bf16` | MTT S5000 | `mp_31` | 32 | bf16 | planned |
| `s80_fp32` | MTT S80 / S3000 | `mp_21` | 128 | fp32 | planned |

> mp_22 (S4000) and mp_21 (S80) use 128-thread warps; mp_31 (S5000) uses 32. Every tuned A-tier kernel in this set was tuned on mp_22, and the tuning record shows the optimum sitting at the 1024-thread CTA ceiling with 32 lanes per query row. Those two facts are warp-size sensitive, so no mp_22 launch configuration should be carried to mp_31 without re-measuring. Source: docs/musa/README.md and docs/musa_attention_tuning_notes.md.

## 可用 kernel 候选

可用于出题、做 expert dispatch 或作为参考实现的 attention kernel，一条一个实现。上游位置、版本与依赖写在溯源记录里（`musa_operator_eval/sources/attention-kernel-candidates.json`，maintainer-only），这里只列选型需要的信息。

| candidate | 类型 | 覆盖 target | dtype | 服务题目 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mate_fmha` | `fused_library` | `s5000_fp16`, `s5000_bf16` | float16, bfloat16, float8_e4m3fn, float8_e5m2 | `kb_l1_97`, `kb_l3_43`, `kb_l3_44`, `kb_l3_30` |
| `mt_flashmla` | `fused_library` | `s5000_fp16`, `s5000_bf16` | bfloat16, float16 | — |
| `mutlass_fmha` | `expert_dispatch_source` | `s5000_fp16`, `s5000_bf16` | undocumented_in_repo_metadata | `kb_l1_97` |
| `torch_musa_sdpa` | `fused_library` | `s4000_fp32`, `s4000_fp16`, `s4000_bf16`, `s5000_fp16`, `s5000_bf16` | undocumented_in_repo_metadata | `kb_l1_97`, `kb_l3_43`, `kb_l3_44`, `kb_l3_30` |
| `kb_level3_musa_handwritten` | `handwritten_kernel` | `s4000_fp32` | float32 | `kb_l1_97`, `kb_l3_43`, `kb_l3_44`, `kb_l3_50`, `kb_l3_30`, `kb_l3_28`, `kb_l3_32` |
| `tilelang_musa_legacy` | `deprecated_source` | `s4000_fp32`, `s5000_fp16`, `s5000_bf16` | undocumented_in_repo_metadata | — |

> The fused attention path is an S5000 story. MATE requires S5000, MT-flashMLA targets compute capability 3.1, and MUTLASS's MP31 work is mp_31 too. mp_31 is S5000; the machine available here is S4000 at mp_22. So the fused-library route the B tier is built around does not exist on the target currently in hand, and the S4000 profile of torch SDPA (five kernels, two assembly SGEMMs plus a softmax) is consistent with a decomposition rather than a fused kernel.

### `mate_fmha` — MATE FMHA forward (mate.mha_interface, and the flash_attn_3 compatibility wrapper)

- 类型：`fused_library`
- 运行要求：gpu S5000；driver >=3.3.5；musa_sdk >=5.2.0 recommended；torch_musa >=2.7；python 3.10 recommended
- 边界：head_dim_max — 512；alignment_fp16_bf16_without_qv — Q/K and V head dim must be divisible by 2；alignment_fp8_without_qv — divisible by 4；alignment_with_qv — divisible by 8, and V head dim <= 512；layout — BSHD; the documented tensor shapes are (batch, seqlen, nheads, headdim)
- This is the only candidate that provides a genuine fused forward attention path, and its argument list maps onto the B-tier SDPA task contract almost field for field: window_size (-1, -1) for unbounded, causal, softmax_scale, return_softmax_lse, pack_gqa. It is also BSHD-native while the B-tier task is BHSD, so a MATE-based dispatch has to transpose, which is itself a dispatch-cost question worth grading.

### `mt_flashmla` — MT-flashMLA

- 类型：`fused_library`
- 运行要求：gpu MooreThreads GPU, compute capability 3.1；musa >=4.0.0；torch_musa >=2.5.0
- 边界：scope — decoding only, not a general forward attention kernel
- Narrower than MATE and superseded by it for general forward attention, but it is a second, independent mp_31 attention implementation. Useful as a cross-check that a MATE result is not an artifact of one kernel family. Not usable for any entry in the attention set, all of which are forward.

### `mutlass_fmha` — MUTLASS experimental/fmha (source-level)

- 类型：`expert_dispatch_source`
- 运行要求：gpu MP31-oriented；note source only; no documented wheel-level entry point
- 边界：usability — individual .mu files do not compile standalone; they depend on sibling headers, build configuration and a matching MUSA SDK
- This is the kind of source a maintainer reads when writing the expert dispatch or an A-tier kernel, not something to call at runtime. It is the honest answer to 'where does the expert knowledge come from' for mp_31.

### `torch_musa_sdpa` — torch_musa SDPA and the muDNN SDP integration

- 类型：`fused_library`
- 运行要求：gpu not documented as arch-limited in the sources consulted；note the only candidate that plausibly covers mp_22 as well as mp_31
- 边界：open_question — whether the fused muDNN SDP path is selected on mp_22 at all, and for which shapes
- This is the route the existing B-tier SDPA task assumes for its fused_library path. The S4000 profile of problem 97 shows five device kernels, two assembly SGEMMs plus a softmax, which is a decomposition rather than a fused kernel. That is one shape at one dtype and does not settle whether the fused path exists on mp_22; it does mean the fused route must be probed per configuration rather than assumed. Resolving this is the first thing probe_sdpa.py should do on the real machine.

### `kb_level3_musa_handwritten` — The hand-written MUSA attention kernels already in this repository

- 类型：`handwritten_kernel`
- 运行要求：gpu MTT S4000, tuned for mp_22；dtype float32
- 边界：warp_size_sensitivity — tuned on mp_22 at 128-thread warps with the optimum at 1024 threads per CTA; not transferable to mp_31 at 32-thread warps without re-measuring；dtype — float32 only；shared_memory — launch configurations are valid only for the head_dim they were measured on
- These are the only attention kernels in hand that actually run on the machine available. They are A-tier answers, and they are also the naive-side data the B-tier admission gate needs. They are not candidates for the S5000 fused path.

### `tilelang_musa_legacy` — TileLang MUSA legacy snapshot

- 类型：`deprecated_source`
- 运行要求：note snapshot not present locally; see the dangling references in the attention set
- 边界：status — deprecated upstream; the revision record calls it the final snapshot
- Recorded because the project's own source record lists it as an S4000/S5000 kernel reference candidate. Nothing can be said about its actual coverage from here: the snapshot is not in the repository and the revision is deprecated. Treat the claim in the source record as unverified until someone looks at the tree.

候选清单记录的缺口：

- No candidate provides a fused forward attention path on mp_22. If the B-tier attention task is to be graded on S4000, either a fused path must be established there (probe first) or the task's library_policy must be rewritten so that fused_library is not the expected path.
- Nothing here has been executed. Every dtypes, limits and alignment field above is transcribed from upstream documentation, not measured on hardware.
- MT-flashMLA and MUTLASS fmha are mp_31 decode/source-level artifacts; the attention set is entirely forward attention, so neither maps onto a current entry.

## 逐题明细

### kb_l1_97 — L1/97 ScaledDotProductAttention

- 参考实现：`KernelBench/level1/97_ScaledDotProductAttention.py`（`Model`）
  - sha256 `a07ca5135657c2ea…`，24 行
- A 类答案：`KernelBench/level1_musa/problem_97/model_new.py`（216 行）
- 结构：plain F.scaled_dot_product_attention over already-split Q/K/V, no mask, no GQA
- 形状说明：head_dim 1024 is what rules out the flash-tile design here: the q/o state alone is about 8KB per row, so the band width collapses to at most 8 rows and latency starvation beats the bandwidth saved.

| 阶段 | target | 来源 | 参考 ms | 提交 ms | speedup |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| a_tier_naive | `s4000_fp32` | `kernelbench_eval_json` | - | 38200.0 | - |
| a_tier_tuned | `s4000_fp32` | `attn_perf_csv` | 76.360 | 191.026 | 0.3997x |

- The tuning record shows this problem spent many rounds far behind: 38176ms, then 3712ms after fixing uncoalesced access, then 1151ms after row-band K/V reuse, then 191ms once the two-stage register-tiled SGEMM replaced the flash-tile attempt.
- This is the same shape family as the B-tier sdpa_forward_pilot task, so its trace and dispatch contract can be reused verbatim.

### kb_l3_43 — L3/43 MinGPTCausalAttention

- 参考实现：`KernelBench/level3/43_MinGPTCausalAttention.py`（`Model`）
  - sha256 `9d280c98c015edca…`，64 行
- A 类答案：`KernelBench/level3_musa/problem_43/model_new.py`（313 行）
- 结构：fused QKV linear, split into heads, scaled QK^T, top-left causal masked_fill(-inf), softmax, P.V, output projection

| 阶段 | target | 来源 | 参考 ms | 提交 ms | speedup |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| a_tier_initial | `s4000_fp32` | `attn_perf_csv` | 47.766 | 1561.2 | 0.0306x |
| a_tier_tuned | `s4000_fp32` | `attn_perf_csv` | 47.679 | 140.849 | 0.3385x |

- The tuned kernel is a flash-tile band: FMHA_TILE_BM 32, FMHA_TILE_BN 32, 32 lanes per query row, 1024 threads per CTA, shared arrays padded by one element to break bank conflicts.
- The intermediate band version was 1561ms and the first flash-tile attempt at BM16/BN32 was slower still (668ms core-only), so the thread count and tile size here are measured optima, not defaults.

### kb_l3_44 — L3/44 MiniGPTBlock

- 参考实现：`KernelBench/level3/44_MiniGPTBlock.py`（`Model`）
  - sha256 `e73093b5d6648474…`，97 行
- A 类答案：`KernelBench/level3_musa/problem_44/model_new.py`（317 行）
- 结构：a full MiniGPT transformer block: the causal attention of 43 plus the MLP and both residual paths

| a_tier_initial | `s4000_fp32` | `attn_perf_csv` | 106.250 | 1619.8 | 0.0656x |
| a_tier_tuned | `s4000_fp32` | `attn_perf_csv` | 106.179 | 199.693 | 0.5317x |

- Shares the kernel source with 43; the higher final ratio reflects the MLP share of the block rather than a better attention kernel.

### kb_l3_50 — L3/50 ReLUSelfAttention

- 参考实现：`KernelBench/level3/50_ReLUSelfAttention.py`（`Model`）
  - sha256 `08768b53a425354e…`，67 行
- A 类答案：`KernelBench/level3_musa/problem_50/model_new.py`（275 行）
- 结构：causal self-attention with relu on the masked scores instead of softmax, so there is no denominator

| 阶段 | target | 来源 | 参考 ms | 提交 ms | speedup |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| a_tier_initial | `s4000_fp32` | `attn_perf_csv` | 19.263 | 523.439 | 0.0368x |
| a_tier_tuned | `s4000_fp32` | `attn_perf_csv` | 19.263 | 57.205 | 0.3367x |

- Because there is no softmax denominator, the relu variant is a pure streaming weighted sum and needs no online rescale; the same kernel handles both modes.

### kb_l3_31 — L3/31 VisionAttention

- 参考实现：`KernelBench/level3/31_VisionAttention.py`（`Model`）
  - sha256 `96c0d2c7a18b4219…`，40 行
- A 类答案：`KernelBench/level3_musa/problem_31/model_new.py`（221 行）
- 结构：single dense multi-head attention over a flattened 128x128 image, no mask, no causal
- 形状说明：16384 tokens at head_dim 32 is the long-sequence small-head case: the score matrix is quadratic in 16384 while the per-row state is tiny.

| 阶段 | target | 来源 | 参考 ms | 提交 ms | speedup |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| a_tier_initial | `s4000_fp32` | `attn_perf_csv` | 76.237 | 2949.7 | 0.0258x |
| a_tier_intermediate | `s4000_fp32` | `attn_perf_csv` | 75.882 | 526.967 | 0.1440x |
| a_tier_tuned | `s4000_fp32` | `attn_perf_csv` | 76.063 | 291.363 | 0.2611x |

- The final design abandons flash-tile entirely and materializes S/P through a two-stage GEMM plus a global row softmax. On a dense long-sequence small-head problem the extra 8.6GB of intermediates costs less than the low arithmetic intensity of streaming rescale.
- Shared memory budget scales as band x head_dim, so the BM128 configuration that won here fails outright at head_dim 96. A launch configuration is only valid for the head_dim it was measured on.

### kb_l3_30 — L3/30 SwinTransformerV2

- 参考实现：`KernelBench/level3/30_SwinTransformerV2.py`（`Model`）
  - sha256 `7d1c6195d4f15a88…`，539 行
- A 类答案：`KernelBench/level3_musa/problem_30/model_new.py`（661 行）
- 结构：shifted-window attention with relative position bias over 7x7=49-token windows
- 形状说明：The window is 49 tokens, which is smaller than one warp's worth of work at mp_22, so the parallel decomposition is the whole problem.

| 阶段 | target | 来源 | 参考 ms | 提交 ms | speedup |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| a_tier_initial | `s4000_fp32` | `attn_perf_csv` | 61.157 | 110.389 | 0.5540x |
| a_tier_tuned | `s4000_fp32` | `attn_perf_csv` | 60.900 | 75.406 | 0.8076x |

- The per-row kernel recomputed the whole window of K/V for every query row; one CTA per (window, head) that stages the entire window once cut the attention portion from 52ms to 18.5ms.
- This is the closest entry to parity in the set at 0.81x, and the remaining gap is attributed to the serial per-row softmax inside the window kernel.

## Level 1 A 类归档资产

`deepseek_api_level1_musa_s4000_baseline/` 存档了 100 道 Level 1 的手写 MUSA kernel 评测结果（MTT S4000 / mp_22 / fp32，5 次正确性 + 100 次 MUSA event 计时）。其中 99 道进入了对照，相对 torch 的几何均值 speedup 0.1262，中位数 0.1693。

未进入对照的题：

- p72：no timing (runtime=-1.0) because correctness did not pass

> p72 的排除是评测侧的已知问题：该题的正确性对比是在与一个错位的 muDNN grouped ConvTranspose3d 参考比较，归档里的 kernel 相对 CPU 标准公式逐位一致。它不应该被算成 A 类的失败，但在参考修好之前也不该进入 B 类的准入对照。

这份归档同时是 B 类 `naive / expert >= 1.3` 准入用的 naive 侧数据：归档里的提交是不做库分派的手写 kernel，与 B 类的兜底路径同量级。库路径与归档 kernel 的差距，就是该题上一次分派决策值多少钱的一阶估计。下面按这个差距排序。
